how: D1: git mv cairn/machines/plan_inspector/ cairn/devices/codemother/machines/plan_inspector/ (code, proofs, validations, probes, charter, history, state; git mv keeps the bytes, history_integrity compares against HEAD at the new path after the commit). Its module path becomes cairn.devices.codemother.machines.plan_inspector; every self-import and Path-join spelling inside the machine (e.g. REPO / 'cairn' / 'machines' / name) names the new address. Instance-space under ~/.cairn is untouched. D2: OWNERSHIP. The moved charter's owner names codemother; gated_by stays exactly as it stands (parent D3). The charter write rides the artifact door. D3: CALLERS, repointed in the same act. No tracked code outside the machine imports or path-joins it (git grep over the dotted, slash and Path-join spellings, 2026-11-13, worktree at 19ae9ffde). D4: PROOF cairn/devices/codemother/machines/plan_inspector/proofs/test_plan_inspector_berths_in_codemother.py, one tooth per clause, red-first: before the move clause 1 and 2 read red (the old directory stands; the old module path is imported). Clause 2's tooth is a git grep over tracked .py/.json/bin for the dotted, slash and Path-join spellings of the old address, excluding history.json, state.json, validations/ and .jsonl records. Then every proof under the new address reseals with bin/cairn test --seal --ruling <this id>.
